compile_options_by_target.probe_context: Rust 1.93 Cargo build linked to bundled SQLite 3.53.2
compile_options_by_target.comparison: sort the complete linked runtime vector lexicographically and require exact element-for-element equality
compile_options_by_target.canonicalization: encode every option as its exact UTF-8 bytes, join adjacent entries with one LF byte, and add no leading or trailing LF

trace_contract.comparison: For a selected literal role, statement identity, and scope, compare every callback tuple exactly and in observed order; any callback not present in that literal role scope denies.
trace_contract.normalization: None. Duplicate callbacks remain duplicate observations; consumers must not case-fold, prefix-match, synthesize aliases, or regenerate this oracle from production traces.
trace_contract.authorizer_installation: before the first SQL or PRAGMA statement and retained for the connection lifetime

projector_writer.schema_introspection_scope: schema_revalidation scopes are valid only during mandatory lock-time revalidation, never projector DML

public_reader.data_version_scope: after common defensive configuration and before the pinned one-read transaction is consumed

notes: Pragma virtual tables authorize Select, their literal main-database Read tuples, and a matching base-name Pragma tuple; they are not Function aliases.
